# Zhiyan ZY-Connect | API-First SDK + MCP (zhiyan.delivery v1)

Canonical public developer references:
- https://github.com/luobo656/zhiyan-releases/blob/main/zy-connect/README.md
- https://github.com/luobo656/zhiyan-releases/blob/main/zy-connect/AI-INTEGRATION.md
- https://github.com/luobo656/zhiyan-releases/blob/main/zy-connect/SPEC.md
- https://github.com/luobo656/zhiyan-releases/blob/main/zy-connect/node/zy-connect.mjs
- https://github.com/luobo656/zhiyan-releases/blob/main/zy-connect/python/zy_connect.py
- https://github.com/luobo656/zhiyan-releases/blob/main/zy-connect/mcp/server.mjs

For same-computer video producers prefer API + SDK and durable ACK/retry; MCP is for local AI tool discovery/pairing/preflight, not video transfer. Folder watch is a fallback. Node >=20; Python >=3.9. The app's API-first fail-closed behavior targets Zhiyan v0.5.11 RC. Incoming deliveries create manual-confirm publication jobs, never automatically submit social posts. Never request platform cookies, turn on account switches, test by publicly posting, or expose localhost ports to the internet.
